name: Hearthlight Brazier
description: A compact lidded field brazier of bark-laminate, ash-lined ceramic, and a cultivated Hearthlight Fungus inner chamber that supplements the coals with steady, near-glowless warmth. Made for low-light cooking in the deep woods; keeps coals off the forest floor, muffles open flame, catches sparks and ash, and lets travelers heat food or water with far less risk of wildfire or obvious campglow.
narrative_effects: Permits hot food and water preparation in dry forest without the wildfire risk of an open campfire.
Sharply reduces visible glow and airborne sparks; supports concealed-camp narration.
Standard kit for elven rangers and Heartwarden Watch rotations operating in the deep wood.
Shares the cultivated Hearthlight Fungus tradition of Thornveil's lantern craft; sustained warmth between cooking fires reduces fuel demand on extended patrols.
